## Daredevil Vol 3 1

> It has been a **miserable** last few years. And every time I thought I'd finally hit bottom, [God](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Yahweh_(Earth-616) "Yahweh (Earth-616)") somehow found me a bigger **shovel**. All this pain and all this loss and... and I just can't bear the weight of it anymore and stay **sane**. I **know** that. So this is the way I've decided to be. You can say I'm in **denial**. You can decide I'm not **dealing** or that I'm a **jerk**... That's up to you. No offense, but I don't care. This is how I choose to **cope**.

—[Daredevil](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Matthew_Murdock_(Earth-616) "Matthew Murdock (Earth-616)")

## Synopsis for "Man w/o Fear"

[Daredevil](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Matthew_Murdock_(Earth-616) "Matthew Murdock (Earth-616)") perches precariously outside a window of the main building of [The Cloisters](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Cloisters "Cloisters"), taking in the smells and sounds of a wedding in progress between the children of two New York organized crime families. He has heard rumors that someone here is going to be the target of a hit. As the bride walks down the aisle, Daredevil senses a slight shift in the acoustics of the venue. A portal has opened at the feet of the flower girl. The [Spot](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Johnathon_Ohnn_(Earth-616) "Johnathon Ohnn (Earth-616)")'s hand emerges and Daredevil realizes he is dealing with an attempted kidnapping. Before The Spot can grasp the girl’s ankle, Daredevil swoops in, grabs the girl, and jumps away.

As Daredevil patrols the city pondering the case, he realizes he is being followed. His pursuer shoots projectiles into the air that explode, raining down “chaff” that counteracts Daredevil’s radar sense. Fully blinded from his surroundings, Daredevil picks up the vague impression of an object coming towards him, but is unable to pinpoint [Captain America](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Steven_Rogers_(Earth-616) "Steven Rogers (Earth-616)")'s shield as it flies at his head from behind.

## Synopsis for "Sometimes, in my dreams... I can see."

[Matt Murdock](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Matthew_Murdock_(Earth-616) "Matthew Murdock (Earth-616)") pays a visit to his dad's grave site with [Foggy Nelson](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Franklin_Nelson_(Earth-616) "Franklin Nelson (Earth-616)") in tow.
